#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Executes a typed Callisto release-PR decision. Forge reads stay here; all
# create/update policy belongs to `callisto release-pr decide`.
#
# The managed branch is never pushed with the Git wire protocol: on a public
# repository, GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write `.github/workflows/*` that way, nor
# through createCommitOnBranch's own fileChanges, on any ref (confirmed
# directly against this repository). Instead, the generated
# version-bump changes are committed via the forge commit API onto a
# deterministic staging branch rooted at the current base commit -- which
# never needs to touch `.github/workflows/*`, since that path is inherited
# unchanged from the base -- and only then is the managed branch's ref moved
# onto that commit. A ref move is not itself a write to that path.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$INPUT_CWD"

# This checkout starts on the configured base. Preserve its exact commit for
# both observations; the working tree changes below (git add -A) never
# create a local commit -- the real commit is made remotely, via the forge
# commit API, on the staging branch.
base_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)

# One GitHub 5xx must not strand the release PR until the next push to main: retry transient failures,
# print every failed attempt's stderr, and leave other failures (404, 422) to the caller. `gh pr create`
# is not wrapped, because a retry after an unseen success would fail on the PR it just made.
gh_retry() {
  local attempt=1 delay=2 err code
  err=$(mktemp)
  until gh "$@" 2> "$err"; do
    code=$?
    cat "$err" >&2
    if [[ $attempt -ge 4 ]] || ! grep -qiE 'Something went wrong|HTTP 5[0-9]{2}|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time|timed? ?out|connection reset|unexpected EOF' "$err"; then
      rm -f "$err"
      return "$code"
    fi
    echo "::warning::gh $1 hit a transient GitHub error (attempt $attempt of 4); retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
    sleep "$delay"
    delay=$((delay * 2))
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    [[ -z "${RETRY_RESET:-}" ]] || "$RETRY_RESET" || true
  done
  cat "$err" >&2
  rm -f "$err"
}

release_pr_snapshot() {
  local raw_prs
  # Command substitutions do not inherit set -e, so a failed read must stop here, not later in jq.
  raw_prs=$(gh_retry pr list --state open --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --limit 1000 --json number,headRefName,headRepository,headRefOid) || return $?
  jq -cn \
    --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --arg base_branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
    --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
    --argjson raw_prs "$raw_prs" \
    '{
      schemaVersion: 2,
      repository: $repository,
      baseBranch: $base_branch,
      baseCommit: $base_commit,
      openPullRequests: [$raw_prs[] | {
        number,
        headRepository: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // ""),
        headBranch: .headRefName,
        headCommit: .headRefOid
      }]
    }'
}

snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)
decision=$(callisto --format json release-pr decide \
  --snapshot "$snapshot" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
  --release-branch "$INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH")
decision_kind=$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$decision")

case "$decision_kind" in
  noop)
    echo 'hasChangesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    echo '::notice::No changesets. This action does not publish, tag, download artifacts, or create releases; use the durable repository workflow.'
    exit 0
    ;;
  create)
    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
    existing_pr=''
    ;;
  update)
    existing_pr=$(jq -r '.action.pullRequestNumber' <<< "$decision")
    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
    ;;
  *) echo "::error::Callisto returned unsupported release PR decision kind: $decision_kind"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo 'hasChangesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [[ -n "$existing_pr" ]]; then
  existing_body=$(gh_retry pr view "$existing_pr" --json body --jq '.body')
  body=$(printf '%s' "$existing_body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
else
  body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
fi

read -ra command <<< "$INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND"
command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")
"${command[@]}"
git add -A
test -n "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'; exit 1; }

plan_file=$(mktemp)
callisto --format json release-pr commit-plan --base-commit "$base_commit" --message "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" --out "$plan_file"
local_tree=$(git write-tree)

staging_created=false
cleanup_staging() {
  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
  fi
  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
}
trap cleanup_staging EXIT

# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

reset_staging() {
  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1
}

if reset_staging; then
  :
else
  gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
fi
staging_created=true

jq -n \
  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
  '{
    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
    variables: {
      input: {
        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
        message: {headline: $headline},
        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
        fileChanges: {
          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
        }
      }
    }
  }' > body.json

# A retry may follow a commit the forge made but never acknowledged, which would fail the mutation's
# expectedHeadOid, so each retry first puts the staging branch back on the base commit.
new_sha=$(RETRY_RESET=reset_staging gh_retry api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
remote_tree=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
  exit 1
fi

callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null

if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
else
  if ! gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
  fi
fi
moved_sha=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
  # The PR list can lag a ref move by a moment, and a stale read looks like a changed snapshot.
  # A real concurrent change stays visible, so the last attempt still fails.
  verified=false
  for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
    if callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      verified=true
      break
    fi
    sleep 3
  done
  if [[ "$verified" != true ]]; then
    callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null
  fi
else
  callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null
fi

label_exists=$(gh_retry label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
  gh_retry label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
fi

case "$decision_kind" in
  create)
    create_args=(--head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
    pr_url=$(gh pr create "${create_args[@]}")
    echo "$pr_url"
    pr_number=${pr_url##*/}
    ;;
  update)
    edit_args=(--title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
    gh_retry pr edit "$existing_pr" "${edit_args[@]}"
    pr_number=$existing_pr
    ;;
esac

# The hold workflow drafts the release PR whenever main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. Hand it back only
# when it was built from the current tip; if main moved again during this run, it stays a draft for the next run.
is_draft=$(gh_retry pr view "$pr_number" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft')
tip=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$INPUT_BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
if [[ "$tip" == "$base_commit" ]]; then
  if [[ "$is_draft" == true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number"; fi
else
  echo "::warning::$INPUT_BRANCH moved to $tip while this run built the release PR from $base_commit; leaving it a draft for the next run"
  if [[ "$is_draft" != true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number" --undo; fi
fi

    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo

    [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]] || { echo "::error::could not draft release PR #$number"; exit 1; }
    sleep $((attempt * 2))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Writes how the release PR rebuild ended on the PR's state comment (see hold-release-pr.sh for how it got held).
# Usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>
# Needs GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_SHA. A rebuild that ended with the PR still a draft, because main moved
# again, leaves the hold note: a newer run is already on its way.
set -euo pipefail

release_branch="${1:?usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>}"
outcome="${2:?outcome}"
run_url="${3:?run url}"

# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=release-pr-note.sh
source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/release-pr-note.sh"

prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
found=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
  [.[] | select((.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--"))))][0]
  | if . == null then "" else "\(.number) \(.isDraft)" end' <<< "$prs")
[[ -n "$found" ]] || exit 0
read -r number is_draft <<< "$found"

case "$outcome" in
  success)
    if [[ "$is_draft" == false ]]; then release_pr_note ready "$number"; fi
    ;;
  failure)
    release_pr_note failed "$number" "$run_url"
    ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Keeps one comment on the release PR that says why it is held, so a draft needs no trip to the Actions tab.
# Source it and call `release_pr_note`, or run it: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]
# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY; GITHUB_SHA names the push the note is about.
set -euo pipefail

release_pr_note() {
  local state="$1" pr="$2" run_url="${3:-}"
  local marker='<!-- callisto-release-pr-state -->'
  local sha="${GITHUB_SHA:-}" body existing
  local short="${sha:0:7}"
  case "$state" in
    held)
      body="Held as a draft: \`main\` moved to \`$short\`, so this PR may be stale. The Release workflow marks it ready after it rebuilds the PR from the new tip."
      ;;
    ready)
      body="Ready: rebuilt from \`main\` at \`$short\`."
      ;;
    failed)
      body="Still a draft: the Release workflow could not rebuild this PR from \`main\` at \`$short\`. See ${run_url:-the Release workflow runs}, fix the cause and re-run it; the PR becomes ready when the rebuild succeeds."
      ;;
    *)
      echo "unknown release PR state: $state" >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
  body="$marker"$'\n'"$body"
  existing=$(gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" \
    --jq ".[] | select(.body | startswith(\"$marker\")) | .id" | sed -n 1p)
  if [[ -n "$existing" ]]; then
    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$existing" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
  else
    gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
  fi
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  release_pr_note "${1:?usage: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]}" "${2:?pr number}" "${3:-}"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build one declared Callisto product artifact. This script deliberately owns
# only platform compilation and archive layout; Callisto owns all release
# planning, artifact identity, provenance verification, and publication.
set -euo pipefail

: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND:?must name cli or cross}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET:?must name a supported Rust target}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET:?must name the expected release asset}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT:?must name the checked-out source root}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR:?must name an output directory}"

kind="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND"
target="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET"
asset="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET"
source_root="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT"
artifact_dir="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR"

case "$kind:$target:$asset" in
  cli:aarch64-apple-darwin:callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-apple-darwin:callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cli:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cross:x86_64-unknown-linux-musl:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz)
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'unsupported Callisto release artifact: kind=%s target=%s asset=%s\n' \
      "$kind" "$target" "$asset" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"

case "$kind" in
  cli)
    rustup target add "$target"
    (cd "$source_root" && cargo build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
  cross)
    rustup target add "$target"
    cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5
    (cd "$source_root" && cross build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
esac

2	# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
3	# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
4	# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
8	package="${2:?missing package}"
9	commit="${3:?missing commit}"
10	remote="${4:-origin}"
11	
12	if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
13	  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
14	  exit 1
15	fi
16	
17	version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
18	if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
19	  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
20	  exit 0
21	fi
22	if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
23	  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
24	  exit 0
25	fi
26	major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
27	if ((major < 1)); then
28	  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
29	  exit 0
30	fi
31	tag="v$major"
32	
33	current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
34	if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
35	  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
36	  exit 0
37	fi
38	if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
39	  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
40	  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
41	  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
42	    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
43	    exit 0
44	  fi
45	fi
46	
47	git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
48	git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
49	echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"
50

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
set -euo pipefail

decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
package="${2:?missing package}"
commit="${3:?missing commit}"
remote="${4:-origin}"

if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
  exit 1
fi

version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
if ((major < 1)); then
  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
tag="v$major"

current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Executes a typed Callisto release-PR decision. Forge reads stay here; all
3	# create/update policy belongs to `callisto release-pr decide`.
4	#
5	# The managed branch is never pushed with the Git wire protocol: on a public
6	# repository, GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write `.github/workflows/*` that way, nor
7	# through createCommitOnBranch's own fileChanges, on any ref (confirmed
8	# directly against this repository). Instead, the generated
9	# version-bump changes are committed via the forge commit API onto a
10	# deterministic staging branch rooted at the current base commit -- which
11	# never needs to touch `.github/workflows/*`, since that path is inherited
12	# unchanged from the base -- and only then is the managed branch's ref moved
13	# onto that commit. A ref move is not itself a write to that path.
14	set -euo pipefail
15	
16	cd "$INPUT_CWD"
17	
18	# This checkout starts on the configured base. Preserve its exact commit for
19	# both observations; the working tree changes below (git add -A) never
20	# create a local commit -- the real commit is made remotely, via the forge
21	# commit API, on the staging branch.
22	base_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
23	
24	# One GitHub 5xx must not strand the release PR until the next push to main: retry transient failures,
25	# print every failed attempt's stderr, and leave other failures (404, 422) to the caller. `gh pr create`
26	# is not wrapped, because a retry after an unseen success would fail on the PR it just made.
27	gh_retry() {
28	  local attempt=1 delay=2 err code
29	  err=$(mktemp)
30	  until gh "$@" 2> "$err"; do
31	    code=$?
32	    cat "$err" >&2
33	    if [[ $attempt -ge 4 ]] || ! grep -qiE 'Something went wrong|HTTP 5[0-9]{2}|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time|timed? ?out|connection reset|unexpected EOF' "$err"; then
34	      rm -f "$err"
35	      return "$code"
36	    fi
37	    echo "::warning::gh $1 hit a transient GitHub error (attempt $attempt of 4); retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
38	    sleep "$delay"
39	    delay=$((delay * 2))
40	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
41	    [[ -z "${RETRY_RESET:-}" ]] || "$RETRY_RESET" || true
42	  done
43	  cat "$err" >&2
44	  rm -f "$err"
45	}
46	
47	release_pr_snapshot() {
48	  local raw_prs
49	  # Command substitutions do not inherit set -e, so a failed read must stop here, not later in jq.
50	  raw_prs=$(gh_retry pr list --state open --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --limit 1000 --json number,headRefName,headRepository,headRefOid) || return $?
51	  jq -cn \
52	    --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
53	    --arg base_branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
54	    --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
55	    --argjson raw_prs "$raw_prs" \
56	    '{
57	      schemaVersion: 2,
58	      repository: $repository,
59	      baseBranch: $base_branch,
60	      baseCommit: $base_commit,
61	      openPullRequests: [$raw_prs[] | {
62	        number,
63	        headRepository: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // ""),
64	        headBranch: .headRefName,
65	        headCommit: .headRefOid
66	      }]
67	    }'
68	}
69	
70	snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)
71	decision=$(callisto --format json release-pr decide \
72	  --snapshot "$snapshot" \
73	  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
74	  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
75	  --release-branch "$INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH")
76	decision_kind=$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$decision")
77	
78	case "$decision_kind" in
79	  noop)
80	    echo 'hasChangesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
81	    echo '::notice::No changesets. This action does not publish, tag, download artifacts, or create releases; use the durable repository workflow.'
82	    exit 0
83	    ;;
84	  create)
85	    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
86	    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
87	    existing_pr=''
88	    ;;
89	  update)
90	    existing_pr=$(jq -r '.action.pullRequestNumber' <<< "$decision")
91	    release_branch=$(jq -r '.action.branch' <<< "$decision")
92	    staging_branch=$(jq -r '.action.stagingBranch' <<< "$decision")
93	    ;;
94	  *) echo "::error::Callisto returned unsupported release PR decision kind: $decision_kind"; exit 1 ;;
95	esac
96	
97	echo 'hasChangesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
98	if [[ -n "$existing_pr" ]]; then
99	  existing_body=$(gh_retry pr view "$existing_pr" --json body --jq '.body')
100	  body=$(printf '%s' "$existing_body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
101	else
102	  body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
103	fi
104	
105	read -ra command <<< "$INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND"
106	command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")
107	"${command[@]}"
108	git add -A
109	test -n "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'; exit 1; }
110	
111	plan_file=$(mktemp)
112	callisto --format json release-pr commit-plan --base-commit "$base_commit" --message "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" --out "$plan_file"
113	local_tree=$(git write-tree)
114	
115	staging_created=false
116	cleanup_staging() {
117	  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
118	    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
119	      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
120	  fi
121	  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
122	}
123	trap cleanup_staging EXIT
124	
125	# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
126	# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
127	# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
128	callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null
129	
130	reset_staging() {
131	  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1
132	}
133	
134	if reset_staging; then
135	  :
136	else
137	  gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
138	fi
139	staging_created=true
140	
141	jq -n \
142	  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
143	  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
144	  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
145	  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
146	  '{
147	    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
148	    variables: {
149	      input: {
150	        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
151	        message: {headline: $headline},
152	        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
153	        fileChanges: {
154	          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
155	          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
156	        }
157	      }
158	    }
159	  }' > body.json
160	
161	# A retry may follow a commit the forge made but never acknowledged, which would fail the mutation's
162	# expectedHeadOid, so each retry first puts the staging branch back on the base commit.
163	new_sha=$(RETRY_RESET=reset_staging gh_retry api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
164	remote_tree=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
165	if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
166	  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
167	  exit 1
168	fi
169	
170	callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null
171	
172	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
173	  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
174	else
175	  if ! gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
176	    gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
177	  fi
178	fi
179	moved_sha=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
180	if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
181	  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
182	  exit 1
183	fi
184	
185	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
186	  # The PR list can lag a ref move by a moment, and a stale read looks like a changed snapshot.
187	  # A real concurrent change stays visible, so the last attempt still fails.
188	  verified=false
189	  for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
190	    if callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
191	      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
192	      verified=true
193	      break
194	    fi
195	    sleep 3
196	  done
197	  if [[ "$verified" != true ]]; then
198	    callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" \
199	      --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null
200	  fi
201	else
202	  callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$(release_pr_snapshot)" > /dev/null
203	fi
204	
205	label_exists=$(gh_retry label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
206	if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
207	  gh_retry label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
208	fi
209	
210	case "$decision_kind" in
211	  create)
212	    create_args=(--head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
213	    pr_url=$(gh pr create "${create_args[@]}")
214	    echo "$pr_url"
215	    pr_number=${pr_url##*/}
216	    ;;
217	  update)
218	    edit_args=(--title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
219	    gh_retry pr edit "$existing_pr" "${edit_args[@]}"
220	    pr_number=$existing_pr
221	    ;;
222	esac
223	
224	# The hold workflow drafts the release PR whenever main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. Hand it back only
225	# when it was built from the current tip; if main moved again during this run, it stays a draft for the next run.
226	is_draft=$(gh_retry pr view "$pr_number" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft')
227	tip=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$INPUT_BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
228	if [[ "$tip" == "$base_commit" ]]; then
229	  if [[ "$is_draft" == true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number"; fi
230	else
231	  echo "::warning::$INPUT_BRANCH moved to $tip while this run built the release PR from $base_commit; leaving it a draft for the next run"
232	  if [[ "$is_draft" != true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number" --undo; fi
233	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Drafts the open managed release PR as soon as main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. The release
3	# workflow marks it ready again only after a refresh built from the new tip, so a failed or skipped refresh
4	# leaves a stale release PR unmergeable instead of mergeable. Usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>
5	# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	release_branch="${1:?usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>}"
9	
10	# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=release-pr-note.sh
11	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/release-pr-note.sh"
12	
13	prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
14	numbers=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
15	  .[] | select(.isDraft == false
16	    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
17	    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--")))) | .number' <<< "$prs")
18	
19	for number in $numbers; do
20	  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
21	    if gh pr ready "$number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --undo; then
22	      echo "::notice::Held release PR #$number as a draft until the release workflow refreshes it"
23	      release_pr_note held "$number" || echo "::warning::could not write the hold note on release PR #$number"
24	      break
25	    fi
26	    [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]] || { echo "::error::could not draft release PR #$number"; exit 1; }
27	    sleep $((attempt * 2))
28	  done
29	done

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Writes how the release PR rebuild ended on the PR's state comment (see hold-release-pr.sh for how it got held).
3	# Usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>
4	# Needs GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_SHA. A rebuild that ended with the PR still a draft, because main moved
5	# again, leaves the hold note: a newer run is already on its way.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	release_branch="${1:?usage: note-release-pr-rebuild.sh <release-branch> <success|failure> <run-url>}"
9	outcome="${2:?outcome}"
10	run_url="${3:?run url}"
11	
12	# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=release-pr-note.sh
13	source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/release-pr-note.sh"
14	
15	prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
16	found=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
17	  [.[] | select((.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
18	    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--"))))][0]
19	  | if . == null then "" else "\(.number) \(.isDraft)" end' <<< "$prs")
20	[[ -n "$found" ]] || exit 0
21	read -r number is_draft <<< "$found"
22	
23	case "$outcome" in
24	  success)
25	    if [[ "$is_draft" == false ]]; then release_pr_note ready "$number"; fi
26	    ;;
27	  failure)
28	    release_pr_note failed "$number" "$run_url"
29	    ;;
30	esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Keeps one comment on the release PR that says why it is held, so a draft needs no trip to the Actions tab.
3	# Source it and call `release_pr_note`, or run it: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]
4	# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY; GITHUB_SHA names the push the note is about.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	release_pr_note() {
8	  local state="$1" pr="$2" run_url="${3:-}"
9	  local marker='<!-- callisto-release-pr-state -->'
10	  local sha="${GITHUB_SHA:-}" body existing
11	  local short="${sha:0:7}"
12	  case "$state" in
13	    held)
14	      body="Held as a draft: \`main\` moved to \`$short\`, so this PR may be stale. The Release workflow marks it ready after it rebuilds the PR from the new tip."
15	      ;;
16	    ready)
17	      body="Ready: rebuilt from \`main\` at \`$short\`."
18	      ;;
19	    failed)
20	      body="Still a draft: the Release workflow could not rebuild this PR from \`main\` at \`$short\`. See ${run_url:-the Release workflow runs}, fix the cause and re-run it; the PR becomes ready when the rebuild succeeds."
21	      ;;
22	    *)
23	      echo "unknown release PR state: $state" >&2
24	      return 2
25	      ;;
26	  esac
27	  body="$marker"$'\n'"$body"
28	  existing=$(gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" \
29	    --jq ".[] | select(.body | startswith(\"$marker\")) | .id" | sed -n 1p)
30	  if [[ -n "$existing" ]]; then
31	    gh api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$existing" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
32	  else
33	    gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/issues/$pr/comments" -f body="$body" > /dev/null
34	  fi
35	}
36	
37	if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
38	  release_pr_note "${1:?usage: release-pr-note.sh <held|ready|failed> <pr-number> [run-url]}" "${2:?pr number}" "${3:-}"
39	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Build one declared Callisto product artifact. This script deliberately owns
3	# only platform compilation and archive layout; Callisto owns all release
4	# planning, artifact identity, provenance verification, and publication.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND:?must name cli or cross}"
8	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET:?must name a supported Rust target}"
9	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET:?must name the expected release asset}"
10	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT:?must name the checked-out source root}"
11	: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR:?must name an output directory}"
12	
13	kind="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND"
14	target="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET"
15	asset="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET"
16	source_root="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT"
17	artifact_dir="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR"
18	
19	case "$kind:$target:$asset" in
20	  cli:aarch64-apple-darwin:callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
21	  cli:x86_64-apple-darwin:callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
22	  cli:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
23	  cli:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
24	  cross:x86_64-unknown-linux-musl:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz)
25	    ;;
26	  *)
27	    printf 'unsupported Callisto release artifact: kind=%s target=%s asset=%s\n' \
28	      "$kind" "$target" "$asset" >&2
29	    exit 1
30	    ;;
31	esac
32	
33	mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"
34	
35	case "$kind" in
36	  cli)
37	    rustup target add "$target"
38	    (cd "$source_root" && cargo build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
39	    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
40	    ;;
41	  cross)
42	    rustup target add "$target"
43	    cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5
44	    (cd "$source_root" && cross build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
45	    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
46	    ;;
47	esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
3	# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
4	# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
8	package="${2:?missing package}"
9	commit="${3:?missing commit}"
10	remote="${4:-origin}"
11	
12	if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
13	  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
14	  exit 1
15	fi
16	
17	version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
18	if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
19	  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
20	  exit 0
21	fi
22	if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
23	  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
24	  exit 0
25	fi
26	major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
27	if ((major < 1)); then
28	  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
29	  exit 0
30	fi
31	tag="v$major"
32	
33	current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
34	if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
35	  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
36	  exit 0
37	fi
38	if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
39	  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
40	  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
41	  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
42	    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
43	    exit 0
44	  fi
45	fi
46	
47	git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
48	git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
49	echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"
50

name: 'Callisto Release-PR Action'
description: 'Creates or updates a Callisto release PR; durable execution belongs to the repository workflow'
inputs:
  version_command:
    description: 'Version command; defaults to callisto version, which refreshes lockfiles. Callisto appends --emit-decision <decision_path>.'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto version'
  decision_path:
    description: 'Path, relative to cwd, where the version command records the exact release decision this PR carries. Committed alongside the manifest and changelog edits; `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` verifies the merged commit against this file rather than re-deriving release policy.'
    required: false
    default: '.callisto/release-decision.json'
  commit_message:
    description: 'Release-PR commit message'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  title:
    description: 'Release-PR title'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  pr_label:
    description: 'Release-PR label'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto: release'
  branch:
    description: 'Base branch for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'main'
  release_branch:
    description: 'Branch managed for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto/version-packages'
  github_token:
    description: 'Optional GitHub token for pull-request and forge commit API operations. The managed branch is never pushed with `git push`; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient even on a public repository, since the executor never writes `.github/workflows/*`.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` published anything (mode: release only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` published (mode: release only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate mode
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/validate-mode.sh"
    # setup-callisto's own steps, called directly rather than through its
    # `uses:` (both `$/` and an external owner/repo/path@ref resolve against
    # whichever ref invoked *this* action, not necessarily a real one -- see
    # setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh's header). github.action_path
    # is this action's own checked-out directory, so a sibling-relative path
    # always uses the same ref this action itself was invoked at.
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true
    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: auto
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: fallback
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "${{ github.action_path }}/../setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.
    - name: Create or update release PR
      id: version-pr
      if: inputs.mode == 'version-pr'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.version_command }}
        INPUT_DECISION_PATH: ${{ inputs.decision_path }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit_message }}
        INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
        INPUT_PR_LABEL: ${{ inputs.pr_label }}
        INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.release_branch }}
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        # GitHub exposes the installation token as a context, not a guaranteed
        # inherited environment variable. Using the context also works for the
        # repository workflow that invokes this action after checkout.
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"
    - name: Run release
      id: release
      if: inputs.mode == 'release'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run-release.sh"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Runs `callisto release` (mode: release) and fills published/publishedPackages
3	# from its receipt; callisto release's own idempotency makes a redundant run a no-op.
4	set -euo pipefail
5	
6	cd "$INPUT_CWD"
7	
8	runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/callisto-release.XXXXXX")"
9	receipt="$runtime_dir/release-receipt.json"
10	cleanup() {
11	  rm -f "$runtime_dir/npmrc" "$receipt"
12	  rmdir "$runtime_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
13	}
14	trap cleanup EXIT
15	
16	if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
17	  npm_config="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
18	  if [[ -n "${HOME:-}" && -f "$npm_config" ]]; then
19	    cp "$npm_config" "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
20	  else

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs `callisto release` (mode: release) and fills published/publishedPackages
# from its receipt; callisto release's own idempotency makes a redundant run a no-op.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$INPUT_CWD"

runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/callisto-release.XXXXXX")"
receipt="$runtime_dir/release-receipt.json"
cleanup() {
  rm -f "$runtime_dir/npmrc" "$receipt"
  rmdir "$runtime_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  npm_config="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
  if [[ -n "${HOME:-}" && -f "$npm_config" ]]; then
    cp "$npm_config" "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  else
    : > "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  fi
  chmod 600 "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  printf '\n//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' >> "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$runtime_dir/npmrc"
fi

if [[ -n "${PYPI_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  export TWINE_USERNAME=__token__
  export TWINE_PASSWORD="$PYPI_TOKEN"
  unset PYPI_TOKEN
fi

output=$(callisto --format json release --receipt "$receipt")

if jq -e '.nothingToRelease == true' <<< "$output" > /dev/null; then
  echo 'published=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo 'publishedPackages=[]' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo '::notice::Nothing to release.'
  exit 0
fi

packages=$(jq -c '[
    .outcomes[]
    | select(.outcome.kind == "published" and (.operation.role.kind == "registryPublish" or .operation.role.kind == "platformPublish"))
    | .operation.package
  ] | unique' "$receipt")
published=$(jq -r 'length > 0' <<< "$packages")
{
  echo "published=$published"
  echo "publishedPackages=$packages"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

436	      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
437	    timeout-minutes: 60
438	    concurrency:
439	      group: release-execute
440	      cancel-in-progress: false
441	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
442	    permissions:
443	      contents: write
444	      attestations: read
445	    steps:
446	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
447	        with:
448	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
449	          fetch-depth: 0
450	          persist-credentials: false
451	      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
452	        with:
453	          source: local
454	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
455	        with:
456	          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
457	          path: release-source
458	          fetch-depth: 0
459	          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
460	          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
461	          persist-credentials: true
462	      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
463	      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
464	      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a

467	      # gets published.
468	      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2

472	      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
473	        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
474	        with:

476	          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
477	      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
478	        env:
479	          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
480	        run: |

487	          fi
488	      - name: Execute verified release
489	        env:

491	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

493	        run: |

495	          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
496	          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
497	          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

501	            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
502	          fi

504	      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.

556	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

559	          set -euo pipefail

566	            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
567	          fi

file.content:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One run at a time: each run asks `callisto release pending` what is unfinished when it starts, so a run queued behind
# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]] && selected_pending=true
            release_source_sha="${release_source_sha:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "release_pr_number=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$prs")"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # The hold workflow drafts the release PR and says why; say how the rebuild ended on the same comment.
      - name: Say how the release PR rebuild ended
        if: success() || failure()
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REBUILD_OUTCOME: ${{ job.status }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/note-release-pr-rebuild.sh callisto/version-packages "$REBUILD_OUTCOME" "$RUN_URL"

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release just executed is excluded: a release that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Runs `callisto release` (mode: release) and fills published/publishedPackages
3	# from its receipt; callisto release's own idempotency makes a redundant run a no-op.
4	set -euo pipefail
5	
6	cd "$INPUT_CWD"
7	
8	runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/callisto-release.XXXXXX")"
9	receipt="$runtime_dir/release-receipt.json"
10	cleanup() {
11	  rm -f "$runtime_dir/npmrc" "$receipt"
12	  rmdir "$runtime_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
13	}
14	trap cleanup EXIT
15	
16	if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
17	  npm_config="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
18	  if [[ -n "${HOME:-}" && -f "$npm_config" ]]; then
19	    cp "$npm_config" "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
20	  else
21	    : > "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
22	  fi
23	  chmod 600 "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
24	  printf '\n//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' >> "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
25	  export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$runtime_dir/npmrc"
26	fi
27	
28	if [[ -n "${PYPI_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
29	  export TWINE_USERNAME=__token__
30	  export TWINE_PASSWORD="$PYPI_TOKEN"
31	  unset PYPI_TOKEN
32	fi
33	
34	output=$(callisto --format json release --receipt "$receipt")
35	
36	if jq -e '.nothingToRelease == true' <<< "$output" > /dev/null; then
37	  echo 'published=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
38	  echo 'publishedPackages=[]' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
39	  echo '::notice::Nothing to release.'
40	  exit 0
41	fi
42	
43	packages=$(jq -c '[
44	    .outcomes[]
45	    | select(.outcome.kind == "published" and (.operation.role.kind == "registryPublish" or .operation.role.kind == "platformPublish"))
46	    | .operation.package
47	  ] | unique' "$receipt")
48	published=$(jq -r 'length > 0' <<< "$packages")
49	{
50	  echo "published=$published"
51	  echo "publishedPackages=$packages"
52	} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

17	# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
18	concurrency:
19	  group: release

78	  recovery-checks:
79	    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery

116	      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
117	      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
118	      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
119	    steps:
120	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

122	          fetch-depth: 0

142	          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then

145	          fi
146	          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')

149	            exit 1
150	          fi
151	          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then

153	            exit 1
154	          fi
155	          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
156	          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
157	          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
158	          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
159	          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
160	          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
161	          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
162	          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
163	          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
164	          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
165	          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
166	            {

168	              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"

171	            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
172	          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
173	            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
174	            exit 1
175	          else
176	            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
177	          fi

name: Hold release PR

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  hold:
    name: Hold the release PR until it is refreshed
    timeout-minutes: 5
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Draft the open release PR
        run: bash .github/scripts/hold-release-pr.sh callisto/version-packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
