#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Behavior test for .github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh against a real local remote.
set -u
SCRIPT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../scripts" && pwd)/move-floating-tag.sh"
fail=0

tmp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto.XXXXXX")
[[ -n "$tmp" && -d "$tmp" ]] || { echo "mktemp -d failed" >&2; exit 1; }
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t

git init -q --bare "$tmp/remote.git"
git clone -q "$tmp/remote.git" "$tmp/work" 2>/dev/null
cd "$tmp/work" || exit 2
git config commit.gpgsign false
commit() {
  echo "$1" > file
  git add file
  git commit -q -m "$1"
  git rev-parse HEAD
}
c1=$(commit one)
c2=$(commit two)
c3=$(commit three)
git push -q origin HEAD:refs/heads/main

decision() { # <package> <version>
  printf '{"schemaVersion":1,"entries":[{"package":"%s","targetVersion":"%s","reasons":[]}]}\n' "$1" "$2" > "$tmp/decision.json"
}
remote_tag() { git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/$1" | awk '{print $1}'; }
check() { # <name> <expected> <actual>
  if [[ "$2" == "$3" ]]; then echo "PASS $1"; else echo "FAIL $1: expected '$2', got '$3'"; fail=1; fi
}
run() { bash "$SCRIPT" "$tmp/decision.json" cargo/callisto-cli "$1" origin >"$tmp/out" 2>&1; }

decision cargo/callisto-cli 0.12.0
run "$c1"
check "before 1.0.0 no tag" "" "$(remote_tag v0)$(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.0.0
run "$c1"
check "1.0.0 creates v1" "$c1" "$(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.1.0
run "$c3"
check "1.1.0 moves v1 forward" "$c3" "$(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.0.1
run "$c2"
check "an older commit never moves v1 backwards" "$c3" "$(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.1.0
run "$c3"
check "rerun on the same commit is a no-op" "$c3" "$(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.2.0-beta.1
run "$c3"
check "a prerelease moves nothing" "" "$(remote_tag v1 | grep -v "^$c3\$")"

decision cargo/other 1.5.0
run "$c3"
check "a release without the product package moves nothing" "" "$(remote_tag v1 | grep -v "^$c3\$")"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 2.0.0
run "$c3"
check "2.0.0 creates v2 and leaves v1" "$c3 $c3" "$(remote_tag v2) $(remote_tag v1)"

decision cargo/callisto-cli 1.1.0
if bash "$SCRIPT" "$tmp/decision.json" cargo/callisto-cli notasha origin >"$tmp/out" 2>&1; then
  echo "FAIL a malformed commit is refused"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS a malformed commit is refused"
fi

exit "$fail"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Verify permissions that GitHub only enforces when a guarded release path is
3	# actually exercised. Keeping this separate from the generic action-pin check
4	# makes the release authority contract visible and testable on every PR.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml
8	
9	job_block() {
10	  local job="$1" next_job="$2"
11	  sed -n "/^  ${job}:$/,/^  ${next_job}:$/p" "$workflow"
12	}
13	
14	require_line() {
15	  local block="$1" expected="$2" description="$3"
16	  if ! grep -Fqx "$expected" <<< "$block"; then
17	    printf 'release workflow contract failed: %s\n' "$description" >&2
18	    exit 1
19	  fi
20	}
21	
22	version_pr="$(job_block version-pr plan)"
23	require_line "$version_pr" '      contents: write' 'version-pr must write the managed branch'
24	require_line "$version_pr" '      pull-requests: write' 'version-pr must create or update the release PR'
25	require_line "$version_pr" "          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'" 'version-pr must refresh Cargo.lock for coupled Cargo version bumps; the action appends its single authoritative --emit-decision argument'
26	
27	action=.github/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh
28	if ! rg -Fqx 'command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")' "$action"; then
29	  printf 'release workflow contract failed: release-PR action must append the exact decision path once\n' >&2
30	  exit 1
31	fi
32	
33	release_candidate="$(job_block release-candidate version-pr)"
34	require_line "$release_candidate" '          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '\''[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]'\'')' 'release-candidate must validate an explicit source only when it is the exact merged managed PR commit'
35	require_line "$release_candidate" '          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}' 'release-candidate must pass a dispatch input through an environment variable'
36	require_line "$release_candidate" '          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}' 'release-candidate must pass the triggering commit through an environment variable'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Verify permissions that GitHub only enforces when a guarded release path is
# actually exercised. Keeping this separate from the generic action-pin check
# makes the release authority contract visible and testable on every PR.
set -euo pipefail

workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml

job_block() {
  local job="$1" next_job="$2"
  sed -n "/^  ${job}:$/,/^  ${next_job}:$/p" "$workflow"
}

require_line() {
  local block="$1" expected="$2" description="$3"
  if ! grep -Fqx "$expected" <<< "$block"; then
    printf 'release workflow contract failed: %s\n' "$description" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

version_pr="$(job_block version-pr plan)"
require_line "$version_pr" '      contents: write' 'version-pr must write the managed branch'
require_line "$version_pr" '      pull-requests: write' 'version-pr must create or update the release PR'
require_line "$version_pr" "          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'" 'version-pr must refresh Cargo.lock for coupled Cargo version bumps; the action appends its single authoritative --emit-decision argument'

action=.github/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh
if ! rg -Fqx 'command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")' "$action"; then
  printf 'release workflow contract failed: release-PR action must append the exact decision path once\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

release_candidate="$(job_block release-candidate version-pr)"
require_line "$release_candidate" '          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '\''[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]'\'')' 'release-candidate must validate an explicit source only when it is the exact merged managed PR commit'
require_line "$release_candidate" '          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}' 'release-candidate must pass a dispatch input through an environment variable'
require_line "$release_candidate" '          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}' 'release-candidate must pass the triggering commit through an environment variable'
require_line "$release_candidate" '          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"' 'release-candidate must not interpolate user-controlled SHA input into shell'
require_line "$release_candidate" '            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '\''.pending[0].source // empty'\'')' 'release-candidate must consider a pending older release first'
require_line "$release_candidate" '          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then' 'release-candidate must require the source on main history'

build_artifact="$(job_block build-artifact build)"
require_line "$build_artifact" '      contents: read' 'each target build must read the intent-bound source tree'
require_line "$build_artifact" '      attestations: write' 'each target build must create provenance attestations'
require_line "$build_artifact" '      id-token: write' 'each target build must mint the Sigstore OIDC identity'
require_line "$build_artifact" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent' 'each target build must keep the release handoff outside either checkout'
require_line "$build_artifact" '          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}' 'each target build must attest its staged artifact bytes'
require_line "$build_artifact" '          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh' 'production artifact builds must use the shared preflighted build recipe'
require_line "$build_artifact" '            target: aarch64-apple-darwin' 'the product matrix must build macOS ARM64'
require_line "$build_artifact" '            target: x86_64-apple-darwin' 'the product matrix must build macOS Intel'
require_line "$build_artifact" '            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu' 'the product matrix must build glibc Linux ARM64'
require_line "$build_artifact" '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' 'the product matrix must build glibc Linux x86_64'
require_line "$build_artifact" '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' 'the product matrix must build musl Linux x86_64'

build="$(job_block build execute)"
require_line "$build" '          pattern: release-build-*' 'assembly must download every target build by pattern, not by a list of names that a new matrix target can miss'
require_line "$build" '          merge-multiple: true' 'assembly must merge every target build into one artifact directory'
if grep -Eq '^          name: release-build-' <<< "$build"; then
  printf 'release workflow contract failed: assembly must not name individual target builds\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
require_line "$build" '          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"' 'assembly must create the exact three-slot artifact manifest'

plan="$(job_block plan build-artifact)"
require_line "$plan" '          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}' 'planning must use one resolved current orchestration revision'
require_line "$plan" '          path: release-source' 'planning must check out the explicit release source separately'
require_line "$plan" '          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}' 'planning must pass the coordinator revision through an environment variable'
require_line "$plan" '            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \' 'planning must bind the current coordinator without shell interpolation'
require_line "$plan" '            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \' 'planning must bind the exact release source checkout'

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]' 'PR merge is the release approval; execute must depend directly on the plan and verified build, not a GitHub Environment gate'
require_line "$execute" '            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"' 'execute must reject a build handoff whose immutable intent differs from planning'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent' 'execute must download release-intent outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build' 'execute must download release-build outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: release-source' 'execute must use an explicit release-source checkout'
require_line "$execute" '          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}' 'execution must pass the coordinator revision through an environment variable'
require_line "$execute" '          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")' 'execute must pass the explicit source checkout, coordinator revision, and mandatory receipt path to the current Callisto coordinator'

ci_workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml
checkout_count=$(rg -n 'uses: actions/checkout@' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
credential_free_checkout_count=$(rg -n 'persist-credentials: false' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
if [[ "$checkout_count" != "$credential_free_checkout_count" ]]; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: every Callisto CI checkout must disable persisted credentials\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

require_line "$version_pr" '          persist-credentials: false' 'version-pr never git-pushes -- it commits through the forge API -- so it must not persist Git credentials'

if ! rg -Fqx '      - run: just release-workflow-behavior' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must run the behavioral release workflow harness\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '  release-artifact-preflight:' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must preflight every production artifact build recipe\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '        run: just workflow-contracts' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '    bash .github/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh' justfile; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: CI must test the shared release artifact build script\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '          - id: macos-arm64' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: aarch64-apple-darwin' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: artifact preflight must cover all three product targets\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          persist-credentials: true' 'execute pushes the release tag with a plain git push (dispatch_tag) -- unlike every other job it has no other way to authenticate, so it must persist Git credentials'

if rg -n '^  environment-policy:$|^    environment: release$' "$workflow" > /dev/null; then
  printf 'release workflow contract failed: a merged release PR is the only approval; no Environment reviewer gate may delay execute\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if rg -U 'run: \|(?s:.*?)\$\{\{ inputs\.' .github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml > /dev/null; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: composite-action inputs must enter shell through named environment variables\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The tests that lint generated workflows fail without zizmor and actionlint, so every workflow that runs them installs both.
for file in .github/workflows/*.yml; do
  if rg -q 'run: just (test|coverage)' "$file" && ! rg -q 'install-workflow-linters' "$file"; then
    printf 'workflow contract failed: %s runs the tests but never installs the workflow linters (install-workflow-linters)\n' "$file" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Policy check for the release workflow: the rules that stop a wrong publish or a leaked credential, asserted on the
3	# parsed YAML, plus the artifact target tables that must agree across the config, CI, build script and installer.
4	# Usage: verify-release-workflow-policy.sh [workflow.yml]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	exec python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
7	import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys
8	
9	DEFAULT = ".github/workflows/callisto-release.yml"
10	CONFIG = "callisto.toml"
11	CI_WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml"
12	BUILD_SCRIPT = ".github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh"
13	INSTALLER = ".github/actions/setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh"
14	COORDINATOR_CONST_SRC = "crates/callisto-model/src/release/github.rs"
15	# Deny-by-default: every `write` scope a job may hold, named explicitly, so a new write permission cannot be added
16	# unnoticed.
17	ALLOWED_WRITES = {
18	    "version-pr": {"contents", "pull-requests"},
19	    "build-artifact": {"attestations", "id-token"},
20	    "execute": {"contents"},
21	    "drain": {"actions"},
22	}
23	# The only secrets the publishing job may reference.
24	EXECUTE_SECRETS = {"CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN"}
25	
26	
27	def load(path):
28	    if shutil.which("yq"):
29	        out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
30	        return json.loads(out)
31	    try:
32	        import yaml
33	    except ImportError:
34	        sys.exit("policy check needs yq or python3 PyYAML")
35	    with open(path) as f:
36	        return yaml.safe_load(f)
37	
38	
39	def walk(node):
40	    yield node
41	    if isinstance(node, dict):
42	        for v in node.values():
43	            yield from walk(v)
44	    elif isinstance(node, list):
45	        for v in node:
46	            yield from walk(v)
47	
48	
49	def check(path):
50	    errs = []
51	    wf = load(path)
52	    jobs = wf["jobs"]
53	    if "secrets." in json.dumps({k: v for k, v in wf.items() if k != "jobs"}):
54	        errs.append("secrets referenced outside jobs")
55	    if wf.get("permissions") != {}:
56	        errs.append("workflow-level permissions must be {}")
57	    for name, job in jobs.items():
58	        used = set(re.findall(r"secrets\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", json.dumps(job)))
59	        if name != "execute" and used:
60	            errs.append(f"{name}: secrets referenced outside execute")
61	        if name == "execute" and used != EXECUTE_SECRETS:
62	            errs.append(f"execute: secrets must be exactly {sorted(EXECUTE_SECRETS)}, found {sorted(used)}")
63	        perms = job.get("permissions")
64	        if not isinstance(perms, dict) or not perms:
65	            errs.append(f"{name}: permissions must be declared per job")
66	            perms = {}
67	        for scope, level in perms.items():
68	            if level == "write-all":
69	                errs.append(f"{name}: write-all")
70	            if level == "write" and scope not in ALLOWED_WRITES.get(name, set()):
71	                errs.append(f"{name}: {scope}: write is not in that job's allowed write scopes")
72	        if any(isinstance(n, dict) and "environment" in n for n in walk(job)):
73	            errs.append(f"{name}: environment key forbidden (merge is the approval)")
74	        for step in job.get("steps", []):
75	            if str(step.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/checkout@"):
76	                w = step.get("with") or {}
77	                keep = name == "execute" and w.get("path") == "release-source"
78	                if w.get("persist-credentials") is not keep:
79	                    errs.append(f"{name}: checkout persist-credentials must be {str(keep).lower()}")
80	
81	    # Only a GitHub-verified merge commit of the managed release PR on main is released.
82	    rc = jobs.get("release-candidate", {})
83	    if "github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'" not in str(rc.get("if", "")):
84	        errs.append("release-candidate must require refs/heads/main")
85	    script = next((s.get("run", "") for s in rc.get("steps", []) if s.get("id") == "candidate"), "")
86	    for needle, why in (
87	        ("^[0-9a-f]{40}$", "a full 40-hex release_source_sha"),
88	        (".merge_commit_sha == $sha", "the PR's exact merge commit"),
89	        ('"$verified" == true', "a verified commit"),
90	    ):
91	        if needle not in script:
92	            errs.append(f"release-candidate must require {why}")
93	
94	    # execute is the one irreversible job: cancelling the run must stop it, and it releases the verified source.
95	    ex = jobs.get("execute", {})
96	    ex_if = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(ex.get("if", "")))
97	    if "!cancelled()" not in ex_if or re.search(r"\balways\(\)", ex_if):
98	        errs.append("execute must gate on !cancelled(), not always()")
99	    src = [
100	        s for s in ex.get("steps", [])
101	        if str(s.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/checkout@") and (s.get("with") or {}).get("path") == "release-source"
102	    ]
103	    if len(src) != 1 or src[0]["with"].get("ref") != "${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}":
104	        errs.append("execute must check out release_source_sha")
105	    return errs
106	
107	
108	def matrix_pairs(path, job):
109	    wf = load(path)
110	    return {(e.get("target"), e.get("asset")) for e in wf["jobs"][job]["strategy"]["matrix"]["include"]}
111	
112	
113	def table_agreement(paths):
114	    """Every hand-copied target/asset table must equal callisto.toml's [[release.artifact]]."""
115	    errs = []
116	    try:
117	        import tomllib
118	        with open(paths["config"], "rb") as f:
119	            declared = tomllib.load(f).get("release", {}).get("artifact", [])
120	        rust = {(a["target"], a["asset-name"]) for a in declared}
121	    except ImportError:  # python < 3.11: read the artifact tables by text
122	        text = open(paths["config"]).read()
123	        rust = set(re.findall(r'target\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"\s*\nasset-name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text))
124	    if not rust:
125	        return [f"{paths['config']}: no [[release.artifact]] target/asset-name pairs found"]
126	    rust_assets = {a for _, a in rust}
127	
128	    def compare(label, found):
129	        for t, a in sorted(rust - found):
130	            errs.append(f"{label}: missing ({t}, {a}) declared in {paths['config']}")
131	        for t, a in sorted(found - rust):
132	            errs.append(f"{label}: ({t}, {a}) disagrees with {paths['config']}")
133	
134	    compare(f"{paths['release']} build-artifact matrix", matrix_pairs(paths["release"], "build-artifact"))
135	    ci = load(paths["ci"])
136	    ci_pairs = set()
137	    for job in ci["jobs"].values():
138	        for e in (job.get("strategy") or {}).get("matrix", {}).get("include", []) or []:
139	            if "target" in e and "asset" in e:
140	                ci_pairs.add((e["target"], e["asset"]))
141	    compare(f"{paths['ci']} preflight matrix", ci_pairs)
142	    script = open(paths["script"]).read()

# Local actions are commit-bound by the checkout. Every external GitHub action
# must use its full immutable commit hash; Docker actions must use an immutable
# content digest.
set -euo pipefail

status=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  reference=${line#*uses: }
  reference=${reference%% #*}
  reference=${reference//[[:space:]]/}
  # Workspace-relative and GitHub's self-repository references are bound to
  # local repository content; only external actions need an explicit pin.
  [[ "$reference" == ./* || "$reference" == '$/'* ]] && continue
  if [[ "$reference" == docker://* ]]; then
    valid='^docker://[^@[:space:]]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  else
    valid='^[^@[:space:]]+@[0-9a-f]{40}$'
  fi
  if [[ ! "$reference" =~ $valid ]]; then
    printf 'mutable or malformed external action reference: %s\n' "$line" >&2
    status=1
  fi
done < <(rg --no-heading --glob '*.yml' --glob '*.yaml' '^\s*uses:\s*' .github)
codeowners=.github/CODEOWNERS
if [[ ! -f "$codeowners" ]] \
  || ! rg -q '^/\.github/workflows/\s+@[^[:space:]]+$' "$codeowners" \
  || ! rg -q '^/\.github/actions/\s+@[^[:space:]]+$' "$codeowners"; then
  printf 'CODEOWNERS must cover .github/workflows/ and .github/actions/ with a real owner\n' >&2
  status=1
fi
exit "$status"

18	    exit 1
19	  fi

25	require_line "$version_pr" "          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'" 'version-pr must refresh Cargo.lock for coupled Cargo version bumps; the action appends its single authoritative --emit-decision argument'

43	require_line "$build_artifact" '      attestations: write' 'each target build must create provenance attestations'

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Policy check for the release workflow: the rules that stop a wrong publish or a leaked credential, asserted on the
3	# parsed YAML, plus the artifact target tables that must agree across the config, CI, build script and installer.
4	# Usage: verify-release-workflow-policy.sh [workflow.yml]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	exec python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
7	import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys
8	
9	DEFAULT = ".github/workflows/callisto-release.yml"
10	CONFIG = "callisto.toml"
11	CI_WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml"
12	BUILD_SCRIPT = ".github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh"
13	INSTALLER = ".github/actions/setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh"
14	COORDINATOR_CONST_SRC = "crates/callisto-model/src/release/github.rs"
15	# Deny-by-default: every `write` scope a job may hold, named explicitly, so a new write permission cannot be added
16	# unnoticed.
17	ALLOWED_WRITES = {
18	    "version-pr": {"contents", "pull-requests"},
19	    "build-artifact": {"attestations", "id-token"},
20	    "execute": {"contents"},
21	    "drain": {"actions"},
22	}
23	# The only secrets the publishing job may reference.
24	EXECUTE_SECRETS = {"CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN"}
25	
26	
27	def load(path):
28	    if shutil.which("yq"):
29	        out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
30	        return json.loads(out)
31	    try:
32	        import yaml
33	    except ImportError:
34	        sys.exit("policy check needs yq or python3 PyYAML")
35	    with open(path) as f:
36	        return yaml.safe_load(f)
37	
38	
39	def walk(node):
40	    yield node
41	    if isinstance(node, dict):
42	        for v in node.values():
43	            yield from walk(v)
44	    elif isinstance(node, list):
45	        for v in node:
46	            yield from walk(v)
47	
48	
49	def check(path):
50	    errs = []
51	    wf = load(path)
52	    jobs = wf["jobs"]
53	    if "secrets." in json.dumps({k: v for k, v in wf.items() if k != "jobs"}):
54	        errs.append("secrets referenced outside jobs")
55	    if wf.get("permissions") != {}:
56	        errs.append("workflow-level permissions must be {}")
57	    for name, job in jobs.items():
58	        used = set(re.findall(r"secrets\.([A-Za-z0-9_]+)", json.dumps(job)))
59	        if name != "execute" and used:
60	            errs.append(f"{name}: secrets referenced outside execute")
61	        if name == "execute" and used != EXECUTE_SECRETS:
62	            errs.append(f"execute: secrets must be exactly {sorted(EXECUTE_SECRETS)}, found {sorted(used)}")
63	        perms = job.get("permissions")
64	        if not isinstance(perms, dict) or not perms:
65	            errs.append(f"{name}: permissions must be declared per job")
66	            perms = {}
67	        for scope, level in perms.items():
68	            if level == "write-all":
69	                errs.append(f"{name}: write-all")
70	            if level == "write" and scope not in ALLOWED_WRITES.get(name, set()):
71	                errs.append(f"{name}: {scope}: write is not in that job's allowed write scopes")
72	        if any(isinstance(n, dict) and "environment" in n for n in walk(job)):
73	            errs.append(f"{name}: environment key forbidden (merge is the approval)")
74	        for step in job.get("steps", []):
75	            if str(step.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/checkout@"):
76	                w = step.get("with") or {}
77	                keep = name == "execute" and w.get("path") == "release-source"
78	                if w.get("persist-credentials") is not keep:
79	                    errs.append(f"{name}: checkout persist-credentials must be {str(keep).lower()}")
80	
81	    # Only a GitHub-verified merge commit of the managed release PR on main is released.
82	    rc = jobs.get("release-candidate", {})
83	    if "github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'" not in str(rc.get("if", "")):
84	        errs.append("release-candidate must require refs/heads/main")
85	    script = next((s.get("run", "") for s in rc.get("steps", []) if s.get("id") == "candidate"), "")
86	    for needle, why in (
87	        ("^[0-9a-f]{40}$", "a full 40-hex release_source_sha"),
88	        (".merge_commit_sha == $sha", "the PR's exact merge commit"),
89	        ('"$verified" == true', "a verified commit"),
90	    ):
91	        if needle not in script:
92	            errs.append(f"release-candidate must require {why}")
93	
94	    # execute is the one irreversible job: cancelling the run must stop it, and it releases the verified source.
95	    ex = jobs.get("execute", {})
96	    ex_if = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(ex.get("if", "")))
97	    if "!cancelled()" not in ex_if or re.search(r"\balways\(\)", ex_if):
98	        errs.append("execute must gate on !cancelled(), not always()")
99	    src = [
100	        s for s in ex.get("steps", [])
101	        if str(s.get("uses", "")).startswith("actions/checkout@") and (s.get("with") or {}).get("path") == "release-source"
102	    ]
103	    if len(src) != 1 or src[0]["with"].get("ref") != "${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}":
104	        errs.append("execute must check out release_source_sha")
105	    return errs
106	
107	
108	def matrix_pairs(path, job):
109	    wf = load(path)
110	    return {(e.get("target"), e.get("asset")) for e in wf["jobs"][job]["strategy"]["matrix"]["include"]}
111	
112	
113	def table_agreement(paths):
114	    """Every hand-copied target/asset table must equal callisto.toml's [[release.artifact]]."""
115	    errs = []
116	    try:
117	        import tomllib
118	        with open(paths["config"], "rb") as f:
119	            declared = tomllib.load(f).get("release", {}).get("artifact", [])
120	        rust = {(a["target"], a["asset-name"]) for a in declared}
121	    except ImportError:  # python < 3.11: read the artifact tables by text
122	        text = open(paths["config"]).read()
123	        rust = set(re.findall(r'target\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"\s*\nasset-name\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', text))
124	    if not rust:
125	        return [f"{paths['config']}: no [[release.artifact]] target/asset-name pairs found"]
126	    rust_assets = {a for _, a in rust}
127	
128	    def compare(label, found):
129	        for t, a in sorted(rust - found):
130	            errs.append(f"{label}: missing ({t}, {a}) declared in {paths['config']}")
131	        for t, a in sorted(found - rust):
132	            errs.append(f"{label}: ({t}, {a}) disagrees with {paths['config']}")
133	
134	    compare(f"{paths['release']} build-artifact matrix", matrix_pairs(paths["release"], "build-artifact"))
135	    ci = load(paths["ci"])
136	    ci_pairs = set()
137	    for job in ci["jobs"].values():
138	        for e in (job.get("strategy") or {}).get("matrix", {}).get("include", []) or []:
139	            if "target" in e and "asset" in e:
140	                ci_pairs.add((e["target"], e["asset"]))
141	    compare(f"{paths['ci']} preflight matrix", ci_pairs)
142	    script = open(paths["script"]).read()
143	    compare(f"{paths['script']} tuples", set(re.findall(r"^\s*\w+:([^:\s]+):([^\s|\\)]+)[\s|\\)]*$", script, re.M)))
144	    installer = open(paths["installer"]).read()
145	    for asset in set(re.findall(r'ASSET_NAME="([^"]+)"', installer)):
146	        if asset not in rust_assets:
147	            errs.append(f"{paths['installer']}: asset {asset} disagrees with {paths['config']}")
148	    return errs
149	
150	
151	def coordinator_path_agreement(path, src):
152	    """The Rust constant is the one spelling; the workflow file must exist there."""
153	    m = re.search(r'RELEASE_COORDINATOR_WORKFLOW_PATH:\s*&str\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', open(src).read())
154	    if not m:
155	        return [f"{src}: RELEASE_COORDINATOR_WORKFLOW_PATH not found"]
156	    errs = []
157	    if m.group(1) != path:
158	        errs.append(f"{src}: coordinator path {m.group(1)} disagrees with the checked workflow {path}")
159	    if not os.path.isfile(m.group(1)):
160	        errs.append(f"{src}: coordinator workflow {m.group(1)} does not exist")
161	    for signer in re.findall(r"--signer-workflow\s+(\S+)", open(INSTALLER).read()):
162	        if not signer.endswith("/" + m.group(1)):
163	            errs.append(f"{INSTALLER}: --signer-workflow {signer} disagrees with {src} coordinator path {m.group(1)}")
164	    return errs
165	
166	
167	path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else DEFAULT
168	paths = {"config": CONFIG, "release": path, "ci": CI_WORKFLOW, "script": BUILD_SCRIPT, "installer": INSTALLER}
169	errs = check(path) + table_agreement(paths) + coordinator_path_agreement(DEFAULT, COORDINATOR_CONST_SRC)
170	if errs:
171	    print("release workflow policy failed:\n  " + "\n  ".join(errs), file=sys.stderr)
172	    sys.exit(1)
173	print("release workflow policy ok")
174	PY

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Local actions are commit-bound by the checkout. Every external GitHub action
3	# must use its full immutable commit hash; Docker actions must use an immutable
4	# content digest.
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	status=0
8	while IFS= read -r line; do
9	  reference=${line#*uses: }
10	  reference=${reference%% #*}
11	  reference=${reference//[[:space:]]/}
12	  # Workspace-relative and GitHub's self-repository references are bound to
13	  # local repository content; only external actions need an explicit pin.
14	  [[ "$reference" == ./* || "$reference" == '$/'* ]] && continue
15	  if [[ "$reference" == docker://* ]]; then
16	    valid='^docker://[^@[:space:]]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
17	  else
18	    valid='^[^@[:space:]]+@[0-9a-f]{40}$'
19	  fi
20	  if [[ ! "$reference" =~ $valid ]]; then
21	    printf 'mutable or malformed external action reference: %s\n' "$line" >&2
22	    status=1
23	  fi
24	done < <(rg --no-heading --glob '*.yml' --glob '*.yaml' '^\s*uses:\s*' .github)
25	codeowners=.github/CODEOWNERS
26	if [[ ! -f "$codeowners" ]] \
27	  || ! rg -q '^/\.github/workflows/\s+@[^[:space:]]+$' "$codeowners" \
28	  || ! rg -q '^/\.github/actions/\s+@[^[:space:]]+$' "$codeowners"; then
29	  printf 'CODEOWNERS must cover .github/workflows/ and .github/actions/ with a real owner\n' >&2
30	  status=1
31	fi
32	exit "$status"

name: Callisto CI & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workflow-contracts:
    name: Workflow Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install workflow validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep,zizmor@1.30.0
      - name: Lint workflow and action metadata
        # actionlint v1.7.12 predates GitHub's documented $/ self-repository
        # syntax. Keep all other actionlint diagnostics strict.
        uses: docker://rhysd/actionlint@sha256:9d36088643581e728c969f35141f88139fec77280b2be23c1f66f8e40e1025e7 # v1.7.12
        with:
          # Docker action arguments are passed directly, rather than through a
          # shell. Keep the exception as one argument so its regex is intact.
          args: -color -ignore=\$/.+
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Audit workflow and action security
        run: just zizmor
      - name: Verify workflow contracts
        run: just workflow-contracts

  fmt:
    name: Code Formatting (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: just fmt-check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy Lints (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: just lint
      - run: just doc-check
      - run: just fuzz-check

  msrv:
    name: Minimum Supported Rust Version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the declared rust-version
        run: |
          msrv=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          rustup toolchain install "$msrv" --profile minimal
          echo "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=$msrv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked

  test:
    name: Test Suite (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest
      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters
      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools
      - run: just test
      - run: just release-workflow-behavior
      - name: Verify Release-PR action against the real callisto binary
        run: bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh

  release-artifact-preflight:
    name: Release Artifact Preflight (${{ matrix.id }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - name: Build the production artifact recipe
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifact-preflight
        run: bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh

  coverage:
    name: Code Coverage & Test Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov
      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters
      # Measures lines only: the Test Suite job installs the real-registry tools and runs those tests for real.
      - run: just coverage 90
        env:
          CALLISTO_ALLOW_MISSING_TOOLS: "1"
      # The workspace total can pass while a small crate is far below threshold, because a few large crates dominate
      # the line count, so each crate is held to the same floor.
      - run: just coverage-per-crate 90

  hygiene:
    name: Dependency & API Hygiene
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0,cargo-machete,cargo-semver-checks
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - run: just machete
      - run: just features-boundary
      # A version only moves on the release PR, so that is where the public API is compared with the published one.
      - if: github.head_ref == 'callisto/version-packages'
        run: just check-api

  security:
    name: Security & Advisory Audit (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny
      - run: just audit

  validate:
    name: Validate Changesets & Workspace Status
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-validate

  release-asset-attestation:
    name: Release Asset Attestation
    # Fork PRs also receive a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN and only lack secrets; same-repo-only is a cost/policy choice.
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      ASSET: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
    steps:
      - name: Select the latest release
        id: latest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag=$(gh release list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --exclude-drafts --exclude-pre-releases --limit 30 \
            --json tagName,isLatest --jq '.[] | select(.isLatest) | .tagName')
          if [[ -z "$tag" ]]; then
            echo "::notice::no published release yet; skipping the release asset attestation check"
          fi
          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Download the release asset
        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$ASSET" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
      - name: Verify the attestation with the installer's flags
        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          verify() {
            gh attestation verify "$1" \
              --repo orin-dx/callisto \
              --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
              --deny-self-hosted-runners
          }
          verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
          # Negative control: a modified copy must fail, so the pass above is not vacuous.
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET" "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
          printf 'x' >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
          if verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"; then
            echo "::error::negative control failed: attestation verification accepted a tampered copy of $ASSET"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "negative control passed: the tampered copy was rejected"

name: Callisto Quality Sweeps

# Slow checks that find what the per-PR gates cannot: parsers fed hostile input, and tests that pass without asserting
# anything. They report; they do not block a merge.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 3 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fuzz:
    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [manifest_editor, manifest_identity, parse_changeset, parse_package_id]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-fuzz
      - name: Install nightly
        run: rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
      - name: Fuzz for ten minutes
        working-directory: fuzz
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: cargo +nightly fuzz run "$TARGET" -- -max_total_time=600
      - name: Keep the crashing input
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fuzz-crash-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: fuzz/artifacts/${{ matrix.target }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  mutants:
    name: Mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 6
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-mutants
      # A surviving mutant means a change to that line would pass every test: report it, do not fail the sweep.
      - name: Mutate the libraries that hold the parsing and version rules
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: cargo mutants -p callisto-model -p callisto-manifests --shard "$SHARD/6" --timeout 120 || [ $? -eq 2 ]
      - name: Summarize
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Surviving mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}"
            if [ -f mutants.out/missed.txt ]; then
              echo '```'
              cat mutants.out/missed.txt
              echo '```'
            else
              echo "none recorded"
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Keep the results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: mutants-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: mutants.out
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: 'Setup Callisto Environment'
description: 'Sets up Rust toolchain, Cargo cache, moon and the .prototools toolchain, and Callisto CLI'
inputs:
  source:
    description: 'Where to obtain Callisto: auto installs the requested release version; local builds validated Callisto checkout source and ignores version. Release jobs must use local.'
    required: false
    default: 'auto'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's
      own invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling
      back to the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  verification:
    description: >-
      Attestation verification of the prebuilt release asset (gh attestation verify, repo
      orin-dx/callisto, signer workflow callisto-release.yml). One of: require = a failed
      verification or missing gh aborts the step and the asset is never run; fallback (default) =
      on failure or missing gh, warn, delete the asset and install from crates.io instead (never
      run the unverified asset); skip = do not verify, warn, and use the asset. Releases built
      before the first attested release carry no attestation, hence the fallback default.
    required: false
    default: 'fallback'

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"

    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true

    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: ${{ inputs.verification }}
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.

261	  release-asset-attestation:
262	    name: Release Asset Attestation
263	    # Fork PRs also receive a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN and only lack secrets; same-repo-only is a cost/policy choice.
264	    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
265	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
266	    timeout-minutes: 45

272	    steps:

283	      - name: Download the release asset
284	        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
285	        env:
286	          TAG: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.tag }}
287	        run: |
288	          set -euo pipefail
289	          gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$ASSET" --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP"
290	          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
291	      - name: Verify the attestation with the installer's flags
292	        if: steps.latest.outputs.tag != ''
293	        run: |
294	          set -euo pipefail
295	          verify() {
296	            gh attestation verify "$1" \
297	              --repo orin-dx/callisto \
298	              --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
299	              --deny-self-hosted-runners
300	          }
301	          verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET"
302	          # Negative control: a modified copy must fail, so the pass above is not vacuous.
303	          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/$ASSET" "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
304	          printf 'x' >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"
305	          if verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/tampered.tar.gz"; then
306	            echo "::error::negative control failed: attestation verification accepted a tampered copy of $ASSET"
307	            exit 1
308	          fi
309	          echo "negative control passed: the tampered copy was rejected"

1	name: Callisto Quality Sweeps
2	
3	# Slow checks that find what the per-PR gates cannot: parsers fed hostile input, and tests that pass without asserting
4	# anything. They report; they do not block a merge.
5	on:
6	  schedule:
7	    - cron: "41 3 * * 0"
8	  workflow_dispatch:
9	
10	permissions:
11	  contents: read
12	
13	jobs:
14	  fuzz:
15	    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target }}
16	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
17	    timeout-minutes: 30
18	    strategy:
19	      fail-fast: false
20	      matrix:
21	        target: [manifest_editor, manifest_identity, parse_changeset, parse_package_id]
22	    steps:
23	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
24	        with:
25	          persist-credentials: false
26	      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
27	      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
28	        with:
29	          tool: cargo-fuzz
30	      - name: Install nightly
31	        run: rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
32	      - name: Fuzz for ten minutes
33	        working-directory: fuzz
34	        env:
35	          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
36	        run: cargo +nightly fuzz run "$TARGET" -- -max_total_time=600
37	      - name: Keep the crashing input
38	        if: failure()
39	        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
40	        with:
41	          name: fuzz-crash-${{ matrix.target }}
42	          path: fuzz/artifacts/${{ matrix.target }}
43	          if-no-files-found: ignore
44	
45	  mutants:
46	    name: Mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 6
47	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
48	    timeout-minutes: 120
49	    strategy:
50	      fail-fast: false
51	      matrix:
52	        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
53	    steps:
54	      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
55	        with:
56	          persist-credentials: false
57	      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
58	      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@a4d3f3f761dcd95cce1b72cb61cb6d1963438177 # v2
59	        with:
60	          tool: cargo-mutants
61	      # A surviving mutant means a change to that line would pass every test: report it, do not fail the sweep.
62	      - name: Mutate the libraries that hold the parsing and version rules
63	        env:
64	          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
65	        run: cargo mutants -p callisto-model -p callisto-manifests --shard "$SHARD/6" --timeout 120 || [ $? -eq 2 ]
66	      - name: Summarize
67	        if: always()
68	        run: |
69	          {
70	            echo "### Surviving mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}"
71	            if [ -f mutants.out/missed.txt ]; then
72	              echo '```'

1	name: 'Setup Callisto Environment'
2	description: 'Sets up Rust toolchain, Cargo cache, moon and the .prototools toolchain, and Callisto CLI'
3	inputs:
4	  source:
5	    description: 'Where to obtain Callisto: auto installs the requested release version; local builds validated Callisto checkout source and ignores version. Release jobs must use local.'
6	    required: false
7	    default: 'auto'
8	  version:
9	    description: >-
10	      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's
11	      own invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling
12	      back to the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
13	    required: false
14	    default: 'latest'
15	  verification:
16	    description: >-
17	      Attestation verification of the prebuilt release asset (gh attestation verify, repo
18	      orin-dx/callisto, signer workflow callisto-release.yml). One of: require = a failed
19	      verification or missing gh aborts the step and the asset is never run; fallback (default) =
20	      on failure or missing gh, warn, delete the asset and install from crates.io instead (never
21	      run the unverified asset); skip = do not verify, warn, and use the asset. Releases built
22	      before the first attested release carry no attestation, hence the fallback default.
23	    required: false
24	    default: 'fallback'
25	
26	runs:
27	  using: 'composite'
28	  steps:
29	    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
30	      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
31	      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
32	      with:
33	        components: clippy,rustfmt
34	        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
35	        save-if: "true"
36	      env:
37	        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
38	        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
39	
40	    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
41	      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
42	      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
43	      with:
44	        auto-install: true
45	
46	    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
47	      shell: bash
48	      env:
49	        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
50	        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
51	        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: ${{ inputs.verification }}
52	        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
53	        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
54	      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.

input.message:
Slop review (read-only). Counts are for what I read: common.rs, the identity/round-trip/persist code in cargo.rs, npm.rs and python.rs, the 6 scripts, the 4 workflows, the 2 action.yml files, and the 8 tests under .github/tests plus the two verify scripts. NOT read: install-callisto.sh, callisto-action/tests/*, setup-callisto/tests/*, the cargo/npm/python test dirs. Paths below are relative to the worktree root. R = crates/callisto-manifests/src, G = .github.

**1. Comments (about 9 history or narration comments, 0 long-block hotspots outside common.rs)**
- R/common.rs:39-53 — 15-line doc on `set_scalar_preserving_decor` explains `dyn TableLike` and ends "Previously duplicated as...". Cut to one line: "Replaces a scalar, keeping its decor."
- R/common.rs:75-85 — FormatFingerprint doc narrates the history ("Previously reimplemented...", "F4: a CRLF Cargo.toml was silently rewritten") and runs 11 lines. Keep: "Detected on open, reapplied on persist, because re-serialization emits LF with no BOM."
- R/python.rs:116-130 — Requirement doc starts with "Previously decomposed independently at three call sites..." Delete that paragraph.
- R/cargo.rs:336-344, R/lib.rs:111 and R/lib.rs:239-241 — "previously two copies", "audit pattern B" and "audit pattern: duplication". Delete the audit and history clauses.
- R/python.rs:511-515 — five-line comment ending "previously only the inline-table variant was handled". Keep only: "as_table_like covers inline and dotted tables."
- R/npm.rs:339-346 — eight-line comment on trim ordering. Shorten to one line: "Trim after the CRLF conversion and before the BOM prepend."
- G/workflows/callisto-release.yml:290-293 and 379-382 — the same 4-line "1 day was too short" backstory is pasted twice. Make it one line: "7 days so a late re-run still finds the artifact."
- G/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh:2-13 — 12-line header explaining the commit API. Trim to 2 lines.
- G/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh:73-74 — 170-character reasons repeated verbatim on two lines. Reuse one string.

**2. Dead code (3)**
- G/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh:39-42 — creates fake `callisto` binaries for the darwin and linux-gnu targets, but the stub `tar` never reads them. Delete.
- R/common.rs:29 — `split_single_operator_prefix` returns `Option` but always returns `Some`, so every `?` at cargo.rs:884, cargo.rs:918 and npm.rs:620 is dead. Return the tuple and drop the `?`s and the `Some(...)` assertions in tests.
- G/actions/callisto-action/action.yml:81-95 vs setup-callisto/action.yml:29-44 — the setup-rust and moon steps are the same in both files. The first copy is not dead, but it should be a `uses:` of the second.
- No `#[allow(dead_code)]` found in the manifests crate (non-test). The workflow inputs I checked are all read.

**3. Needless abstraction (3)**
- R/lib.rs:118-125 plus the three `identity_from_source` functions (cargo.rs:385, npm.rs:171, python.rs:91) — `read_identity` is only a three-arm forwarding match. Reasonable as a facade, so low priority.
- G/actions/callisto-action/scripts/validate-mode.sh (11 lines) — a script file invoked from one step to check an enum. Inline it in action.yml, or let `callisto` validate.
- G/scripts/release-pr-note.sh:37-39 — dual source/run mode, but the real callers only source it. Only the test's `if [[ ... */release-pr-note.sh ]]` branch (test-release-pr-notes.sh:27) exercises the run mode.

**4. Duplicated logic (about 8)**
- G/scripts/hold-release-pr.sh:13-17 and G/scripts/note-release-pr-rebuild.sh:15-19 — the same `gh pr list` plus jq filter ("our repo and (branch or branch--*)"). Move it to a `find_release_prs` function in release-pr-note.sh, which both already source.
- R/cargo.rs:339-379 `set_dependency_version` — hand-copies the "clone decor, build Value, assign" sequence 3 times, although R/common.rs:54 `set_scalar_preserving_decor` exists for it. Extract a `replace_value_keeping_decor(&mut Value, String)` helper. cargo.rs:654 and cargo.rs:1092 are also repeated.
- R/cargo.rs:863-873 `parse_cargo_spec_str` and R/npm.rs:586-597 — the same "bare semver, then VersionReq, then Opaque" ladder. Also R/npm.rs:334-336 re-implements the CRLF replace that `FormatFingerprint::apply` (common.rs:112) does.
- G/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh:36-46 — the `cli` and `cross` arms repeat `rustup target add` and the tar line. Hoist both, keep only the build command in the case.
- G/workflows/callisto-ci.yml:136-168 vs callisto-release.yml:301-329 — the 5-entry target/asset/runner matrix is pasted twice. The policy script guards drift, but it is still a copy. Use one source (the callisto.toml artifacts, or a reusable workflow).
- G/tests/test-hold-release-pr.sh and test-release-pr-notes.sh — `run_case`, `pr`, `verdict` and the gh stub are copy-pasted. Move them to a `lib.sh`.
- G/workflows/callisto-release.yml:32-35, 120-123 and the other checkouts — the same checkout block appears 12 times.

**5. Defensive code for ruled-out states (3)**
- G/workflows/callisto-release.yml:280-283 — `jq 'length > 0'` can only print true or false, so the `case` guard is dead. Delete it.
- G/scripts/note-release-pr-rebuild.sh:23-30 — the `case "$outcome"` has no default. An unknown outcome silently does nothing. Either fail on unknown or take a boolean.
- G/actions/callisto-action/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh:175-177 — on `create`, if the POST fails for any reason it falls back to a forced PATCH, which hides non-"already exists" errors.

**6. Weak tests (4)**
- G/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh:22-37 — stubbed `cargo`, `rustup` and `tar` mean the `cli` path is asserted only by "a file exists". No line checks `cargo build`. The `rg` checks cover only `cross`. Assert the `cargo build ... --target` line for `cli` too.
- G/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh:65-86 — the two rejection cases hit the same `*)` arm. The "removed wasm tuple" case adds nothing, so drop one.
- G/tests/test-hold-release-pr.sh:43-69 and test-release-pr-notes.sh:43-73 — the `ok=1; if ...; then ok=0; else ok=1; fi; verdict "$ok"` idiom is inverted and repeated 15 times. Use `verdict name "$cond"` directly.
- G/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh:34 — `require_line` pins a 480-character jq line verbatim. Any harmless edit fails it, so it is a change-detector rather than a contract. Assert on the jq output instead, which test_release_candidate_recovery.sh already does.

**7. Hardcoded values (the owner's pain point)**
- `callisto/version-packages` appears at G/workflows/callisto-release.yml:163 (twice, plus a regex), 213 and 226, G/workflows/callisto-hold-release-pr.yml:24, G/workflows/callisto-ci.yml:228 and G/actions/callisto-action/action.yml:31. Also about 30 times in the callisto-action tests. Define one `env.RELEASE_BRANCH` or read it from callisto.toml.
- `just@1.58.0` appears 10 times (7 in ci.yml, 2 in release.yml, 1 in the hold workflow). The checkout SHA appears 25 times and the setup-rust SHA about 12 times. Move them to one place or a composite action.
- G/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh:43 — `cross --version 0.2.5` is hardcoded in the script, and test-release-artifact-build-script.sh:62 repeats it. Make it an env var or read it from `.prototools`.
- `macos-14` appears 4 times. The workflow-contract script (line 80), release.yml:509 and release.yml:270 hardcode `.callisto/release-decision.json`, although the `decision_path` input exists. Also `orin-dx/callisto` at ci.yml:297-298 and `main` in release.yml:152 and 163.
- G/scripts/hold-release-pr.sh:20 (3 attempts) and create-or-update-release-pr.sh:33 (4 attempts, with a separate 9x3s loop at line 189) — retry budgets are scattered literals with no shared function.

**8. Misleading names or docs (4)**
- G/tests/verify-release-workflow-contract.sh:61 and 109 — messages say "three-slot manifest" and "all three product targets", but the matrix has 5 targets.
- G/workflows/callisto-release.yml:354-360 "Verify handoff" also runs `mkdir -p release-artifacts`, which build-release-artifact.sh:33 does again.
- R/common.rs:16 — the variable `chars` holds an `Option<char>`. R/common.rs:3-7 says "byte-for-byte identical" but `FormatFingerprint` is bypassed by npm.rs:334. Rename `chars` to `first`.
- G/actions/callisto-action/action.yml:73-78 — a comment about "setup-callisto's own steps" sits above steps that are the duplicate (see #2), so the comment and the structure disagree.

**Three recurring patterns worth a rule or lint**
1. History narration in comments: "previously", "audit pattern", "F4", "used to", "no longer". A one-line grep in CI rejects them in `//`, `///` and `#` comment lines. Also cap doc blocks at 3 lines.
2. Repeated literals in YAML and shell (branch name, tool versions, action SHAs, runner names, paths). Add a "no literal appears more than twice in .github" check, or require `env:` or inputs at the top of the workflow. This is the owner's pain point.
3. Copy-pasted test harnesses and invert-the-condition `ok` idioms. Require a shared `tests/lib.sh` (stub gh, `pr`, `verdict`). Add a rule that each stubbed command is asserted at least once, so unfalsifiable stubs fail review.
